results.title: Council backs Brindlewick tram extension to Verrin Quay
results.content: Tessaly Regional Council voted on Tuesday to extend the Brindlewick tram line by four stops, ending at Verrin Quay. Councillor Odalys Pemberton said the extension would replace the 41 bus. Work is due to start after the winter break, and the council will publish the timetable once the contractor is chosen.

results.title: Brindlewick tram riders react to the vote
results.content: Commuters on the Brindlewick tram line welcomed the council vote. Some riders asked whether fares would change when the line reaches Verrin Quay.
